title: 第68章 暮炊烹鳄肉 锻刃赠佳人第67章 溪涧寻寒铁 怒斩黑鳞鳄
lines: 林间余温缓缓消散，满地冰屑与焦黑碎枝静静铺在青岩溪涧的地面。融化的冰水顺着沟壑蜿蜒流淌，将深色血渍缓缓晕开，方才惊天动地的水火轰鸣彻底沉寂，整片山谷终于回归死寂。
罗止正立于溪间浅滩，双腿发软，方才一记爆裂炎冲膝几乎抽空他体内所有火灵力。脏腑之间撕裂般的钝痛阵阵翻涌，每一次呼吸都牵扯重伤的内腑，闷得他胸腔发堵发闷。
他身上玄岳镇鳞铠的甲片衔接处布满细密裂痕，是先前被黑水鳞纹鳄甩撞青石时震裂所致。铠甲虽卸去了大部分冲击，却没能完全护住脏腑，残留的震荡伤势依旧顽固盘踞在体内，久久不散。
李紫云提着灵角寒霜弓快步走到溪岸，眉目间凝着清晰的担忧，语气轻缓却带着认真道：“你内伤极重，先上岸静坐调息，我拿灵花给你稳住伤势。”
说罢她伸手从腰间储物袋中取出一株清涧凝络花，递到涉水走来的罗止正手中，这是她仅剩两株灵花中的第一株。
罗止正微微颔首，走到岸边青石旁屈膝落座，指尖捻住花瓣含入口中，闭目凝神，借药力疏导体内紊乱冲撞的残余灵力，压制翻涌不止的血气。清涧凝络花药力绵长温润，顺着周身脉络缓缓游走，疏通淤塞经络，调和纷乱内息，一点点化解此战积压的经脉暗伤与气血淤堵，缓慢补还大战损耗的灵气，润物无声地滋养身躯、固本培元。
处理完罗止正这边，李紫云转身走向不远处的随峰。
随峰低低垂着双翼落在地面，身形蔫软无力。先前硬撼黑水鳞纹鳄鳄尾横扫时，双向对冲的狂暴震力尽数灌入体内，脏腑受震内伤、风灵力严重紊乱透支，此刻连正常振翅都透着滞涩沉重，周身气息虚浮不稳。
李紫云蹲至随峰身旁，取出最后一株清涧凝络花递到它嘴边。花瓣入口，温和药力即刻散开，缓缓抚平它错乱的风灵力，舒缓震荡受损的内腑。她指尖温柔顺着它的羽翼轻抚，静静安抚这只力竭负伤的灵兽。
一人一宠各自静守调息，时光缓缓流逝。原本遮蔽山谷的正午强光渐渐柔和下沉，高空烈阳向西偏移，穿透枝叶的碎金光斑褪去灼人的热度，染上一层暖橙调。谷间萦绕不散的水汽被暮色浸染，朦胧雾气泛出淡金柔光，周遭草木光影慢慢拉长，白日的燥热彻底褪去，微凉晚风顺着谷口缝隙悄然漫入，不知不觉间，天色已然步入黄昏。
整片溪涧谷地彻底换了一副光景，冷白天光转为暖昏暮色，溪水倒映着天边沉落的霞光，静谧之中添了几分沉缓暮色。
良久，罗止正缓缓睁开双眼，喉间淤积的腥甜尽数消散，紊乱的气息总算平稳大半。药力慢慢修复体内淤堵的经脉暗伤，透支的灵力恢复少许，胸腹撕裂般的钝痛减轻不少。他抬眸望向溪畔乱石堆深处黑水鳞纹鳄僵直的庞大尸身，沉声开口：“趁黄昏光线尚可，我们处理这头灵鳄的尸体吧。”
话音落下，罗止正撑着青石缓缓起身，忍着体内残余的内伤，缓步走向乱石堆。
李紫云闻言，轻轻颔首，步履平稳缓步跟上，一同走到黑水鳞纹鳄庞大的尸身旁。
她玉手微抬，从腰间抽出一柄清亮细长的灵匕，刃身薄而锋利，在黄昏霞光下泛着细碎冷光。
李紫云屈膝俯身，手腕轻转，灵匕精准切入鳞甲衔接的缝隙。
锋利刃身顺着肌理缓缓划开，她手法娴熟沉稳，力道控制恰到好处，不损甲片完整，一片片厚重坚硬的墨纹鳞甲被整齐剔落。罗止正在一旁默默打下手，俯身将脱落的完整鳞甲一片片捡起，整齐堆叠在旁边干净的青石面上，避免沾染泥沙污损。
剔完周身鳞甲，李紫云动作不停，灵匕顺着脊椎两侧浅划，精准挑出鳄兽紧实凝练的粗壮兽筋。黑水鳞纹鳄常年栖于溪水、搏杀凶悍，兽筋韧性极强、蕴有水系灵韵，是缝制装备的上等素材。
她一点点剥离筋膜牵连，耐心将整条兽筋完整抽出，无断无裂。罗止正伸手接过抽出的兽筋，理顺捋平，有序叠放于鳞甲一侧，分类规整。
鳞甲、兽筋尽数处理完毕后，李紫云再度落刃，刀锋贴着坚硬鳄骨游走，顺着骨缝精准剔割，将依附在骨骼上的大块鳄肉完整剥离。
待大块灵肉尽数脱离骨架，罗止正在一旁托住肉块，李紫云手持灵匕顺势改刀，将硕大的整块鳄肉均匀分切成大小规整的小块，方便收纳储存、日后食用。
两人分工默契、动作利落，在微凉的黄昏晚风里，有条不紊将整具鳄兽躯体尽数拆解归类。
完整鳞甲、坚韧兽筋、新鲜灵鳄肉块分区摆放整齐，无一浪费。
待所有素材整理妥当，此时西天落日彻底沉进山沿，谷内霞光渐褪，暮色快速深重，林间光线愈发昏暗，晚风也添了几分凉意。
罗止正抬眸环顾四周昏暗下来的溪涧山林，沉声开口：“天色太晚，视线不足，不适合继续赶路。我们今夜就地休整，生火御寒歇息一晚，待明日天光再入溪涧后段。”
李紫云垂眸浅笑，语气温和温顺：“好的，听你安排。”
话音落罢，二人即刻分头行动，沿着青岩溪涧岸边四处捡拾干枯枯枝、脱落断木。
不多时，两人各自抱回一堆干燥柴火，尽数堆放在空旷干净的青石空地之上。
罗止正屈膝俯身，双手翻动规整木柴，交错堆叠出一架中空通风的简易柴架，预留出空气流通的缝隙，保证柴火能够充分燃烧、不易熄灭。
待柴架搭筑完毕，他指尖微微一动，一簇细碎温热的火灵力自指尖悄然弹出。
噼啪！
细小火星落于柴架底端的干引火之上，火星转瞬燎原，干燥枯枝瞬间被引燃，明亮的橘色火光腾地窜起，稳稳燃满整座柴堆。
暖融融的火光骤然驱散山间暮色的阴冷，跳动的焰光映亮二人侧脸，也将整片溪涧空地照得通透温热。
一旁的随峰服下清涧凝络花休养许久，体内紊乱的风灵力平复大半，脏腑内伤已然缓解，安静落在火堆旁，温顺蛰伏休憩。
李紫云走到篝火边，弯腰拾起数根粗细匀称的细树枝，取出手中灵匕，顺着枝端细细削磨，将每根树枝顶端削得尖锐锋利，刚好能穿住肉块。
罗止正看她削好烤枝，转身走到堆放灵鳄肉块的青石旁，拿起几块肥瘦相间的灵肉，快步递到李紫云身前。
李紫云伸手接过肉块，拿起削尖的树枝一块块穿起，摆满三支烤枝，随后抬手架在火堆边缘，缓慢翻动烘烤，油脂遇热滴落进柴火，滋啦声响不断，诱人肉香缓缓散开。
忙活完烘烤的事，她低头看向掌心握着的灵匕，借着跳动火光仔细打量，才发现方才拆解坚硬鳄鳞、粗韧兽筋时，刃口多处磕出细小缺口，原本顺滑锋利的刀刃已然不复完整。

The remaining warmth in the forest slowly dissipated, and the ground was covered with ice chips and blackened branches quietly spread on the ground of Qingyan Stream. The melted ice water meandered along the ravine, slowly spreading out the dark blood stains. The earth-shattering roar of water and fire just now was completely silenced, and the entire valley finally returned to deathly silence.
Luo Zhi was standing in the shallows of the stream, his legs were weak, and he had just hit a bursting flame to the knee that almost drained all the fire energy from his body. A dull, tearing pain surged through his organs, and every breath pulled at his severely injured internal organs, making his chest feel congested and stuffy.
The joints between the plates of Xuanyue's scale-suppressing armor on his body were covered with fine cracks, which were caused by the cracks caused by the black water-scaled crocodile hitting the bluestone. Although the armor removed most of the impact, it failed to completely protect the internal organs. The remaining concussion injuries were still stubbornly entrenched in the body and would not dissipate for a long time.
Li Ziyun walked quickly to the stream bank holding the Spirit Horn Frost Bow, with clear concern in his brows, and said in a gentle but serious tone: "You are seriously injured internally. Go ashore first and sit quietly to adjust your breathing. I will give you the spirit flower to stabilize the injury."
After saying that, she reached out and took out a Qingjian Ningluo flower from the storage bag at her waist, and handed it to Luo Zhizheng, who was walking through the water. This was the first of her only two spiritual flowers left.
Luo Zhizheng nodded slightly, walked to the bluestone on the shore and sat down on his knees. He twisted the petals with his fingertips and put them in his mouth. He closed his eyes and concentrated, using the power of the medicine to channel the remaining spiritual energy that was chaotic and colliding in his body, and suppress the surging blood. The medicinal power of Qingjian Ningluo flower is long-lasting and moist, and slowly travels along the veins of the whole body, clearing blocked meridians, harmonizing the chaotic internal energy, and gradually resolving the backlog of meridians and Qi and blood blockage in this battle, slowly replenishing the spiritual energy lost in the war, moisturizing things, silently nourishing the body, strengthening the foundation and strengthening the body.
After dealing with Luo Zhizheng's side, Li Ziyun turned around and walked towards Suifeng not far away.
Sui Feng lowered his wings and landed on the ground, his body limp and weak. When the black water scaled crocodile's crocodile tail swept across, the violent shock force of the two-way conflict poured into the body. The internal organs were shocked and internally injured, and the wind spirit force was severely disordered and overdrawn. At this moment, even the normal flapping of the wings felt sluggish and heavy, and the aura around the body was floating and unstable.
Li Ziyun squatted next to Suifeng, took out the last Qingjian Ningluo flower and handed it to his mouth. When the petals enter the mouth, the gentle medicinal power spreads out immediately, slowly smoothing out its chaotic wind energy and soothing the damaged internal organs. Her fingertips gently caressed its wings, quietly comforting the exhausted and injured spiritual beast.
One person and one pet each quietly regulate their breath, and time passes slowly. The strong midday light that originally obscured the valley gradually softened and sank, and the blazing sun in the sky shifted to the west. The golden light spots that penetrated the branches and leaves lost their scorching heat and were dyed with a warm orange tone. The lingering water vapor in the valley is soaked in the twilight, the hazy mist glows with a soft golden light, the light and shadow of the surrounding vegetation slowly lengthens, the heat of the day completely fades away, the cool evening breeze quietly flows in along the gap at the mouth of the valley, and before you know it, the sky has entered dusk.
The entire stream valley has completely changed its scenery. The cold daylight has turned into warm twilight. The stream reflects the sunset of the sky, adding a bit of gentle twilight to the tranquility.
After a long time, Luo Zhizheng slowly opened his eyes. The fishy sweetness accumulated in his throat dissipated, and his chaotic breath finally stabilized for the most part. The power of the medicine slowly repaired the hidden injuries in the blocked meridians in the body, the overdrawn spiritual energy recovered a little, and the dull pain in the chest and abdomen was relieved a lot. He raised his eyes and looked at the huge stiff body of the Blackwater Scaled Crocodile deep in the rocks by the stream, and said in a deep voice: "While the light is still available at dusk, let's dispose of the body of this spiritual crocodile."
After the words fell, Luo Zhi stood up slowly while supporting the blue stone, enduring the remaining internal injuries in his body, and walked slowly towards the pile of rocks.
When Li Ziyun heard the words, he nodded gently, followed him slowly and steadily, and walked together to the huge body of the black water scaled crocodile.
She raised her jade hand slightly and pulled out a clear and slender spiritual dagger from her waist. The blade was thin and sharp, glowing with a thin cold light under the dusk light.
Li Ziyun bent his knees, turned his wrist slightly, and the spirit dagger accurately cut into the gap between the scales.
Chi——
The sharp blade slowly sliced along the texture. Her technique was skillful and steady, and the force was controlled just right without damaging the integrity of the armor. Pieces of thick and hard ink-patterned scales were neatly picked off. Luo Zhi was silently working aside, leaning down to pick up the intact scales one by one, and stack them neatly on the clean bluestone surface next to them to avoid being stained by mud and sand.
After picking off the scales all over his body, Li Ziyun kept moving, and his spiritual dagger made shallow cuts along both sides of the spine, accurately picking out the tight and thick muscles of the crocodile beast. The black water scale crocodile lives in streams all year round and is a ferocious fighter. Its sinews are extremely tough and contain water aura, making it an excellent material for sewing equipment.
She peeled off the fascia involvement bit by bit, and patiently extracted the entire animal tendon without any breaks or cracks. Luo Zhizheng stretched out his hand to take the extracted animal tendons, smoothed them out, and stacked them on the side of the scales in an orderly manner, classifying them neatly.
After all the scales and sinews were processed, Li Ziyun lowered his blade again. The blade moved against the hard crocodile bones, cutting precisely along the bone seams, and completely peeling off the large pieces of crocodile meat attached to the bones.
After all the large pieces of spiritual meat were separated from the skeleton, Luo Zhi was holding the pieces of meat aside. Li Ziyun held the spiritual dagger and used the knife to evenly cut the huge piece of crocodile meat into regular-sized pieces for easy storage and future consumption.
The two of them had a tacit understanding of the division of labor and neat movements. In the cool evening breeze, they methodically dismantled and classified the entire crocodile beast's body.
Complete scales, tough sinews, and fresh crocodile meat are arranged neatly in separate sections, with nothing going to waste.
After all the materials were sorted out, the setting sun in the west had completely sunk into the edge of the mountain. The glow in the valley gradually faded, the twilight quickly deepened, the light in the forest became darker and darker, and the evening breeze also added a bit of coolness.
Luo Zhi was raising his eyes to look around at the darkening mountain forest of the stream, and said in a deep voice: "It's too late, and the sight is not enough, so it's not suitable to continue on the road. We will rest on the spot tonight, make a fire to keep out the cold, and rest for the night. We will enter the back part of the stream when the light comes tomorrow."
Li Ziyun lowered his eyes and smiled, his tone gentle and gentle: "Okay, I will follow your arrangements."
As soon as they finished speaking, the two of them immediately split up and started picking up dry branches and fallen wood along the bank of Qingyan Stream.
Not long after, the two of them each carried back a pile of dry firewood and piled them all on the open and clean bluestone clearing.
Luo Zhizheng bent over with his knees bent, flipping the regular logs with his hands, and staggered them to create a hollow and ventilated simple firewood rack, leaving gaps for air circulation to ensure that the firewood can be fully burned and not easily extinguished.
After the firewood rack was built, he moved his fingertips slightly, and a cluster of fine and warm fire spiritual power quietly popped out from his fingertips.
Crack!
Small sparks fell on the dry kindling fire at the bottom of the firewood rack, and the sparks instantly set a prairie fire. The dry dead branches were instantly ignited, and bright orange flames shot up to the ground, burning the entire firewood pile steadily.
The warm light of the fire suddenly dispelled the coldness of the twilight in the mountains. The dancing flames illuminated the profiles of the two people, and also illuminated the entire open space in the stream.
Suifeng on the side took Qingjian Ningluohua and rested for a long time. The chaotic wind energy in his body was mostly calmed down, and the internal injuries in his internal organs had been relieved. He quietly fell beside the fire, sleeping docilely.
Li Ziyun walked to the bonfire, bent down and picked up several thin branches of even thickness, took out the spirit dagger in his hand, and sharpened it along the ends of the branches, making the top of each branch sharp and sharp, just enough to penetrate the meat.
Luo Zhi was watching her cut the roasted branches, then turned around and walked to the bluestone where the spiritual crocodile meat pieces were stacked. He picked up a few pieces of fat and thin spiritual meat and quickly handed them to Li Ziyun.
Li Ziyun reached out to take the piece of meat, picked up the sharpened branches, threaded them one by one, and placed three roasting branches. Then he raised his hand and placed it on the edge of the fire, slowly flipping and roasting. The fat dripped into the firewood when heated, making a constant sizzling sound, and the alluring meat aroma slowly spread.
After finishing her work on baking, she lowered her head and looked down at the spirit dagger she held in her palm. Using the dancing firelight, she looked carefully and realized that when she had just dismantled the hard crocodile scales and thick animal sinews, there were many small nicks on the blade, and the originally smooth and sharp blade was no longer complete.
